name: api-tests-postman
description: Testes automatizados de API usando Postman Collection e Newman

scripts.test: newman run postman/collection.json -r htmlextra,json,cli --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/reports/report.html --reporter-json-export newman/reports/report.json
scripts.test:verbose: newman run postman/collection.json -r htmlextra,json,cli --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/reports/report.html --reporter-json-export newman/reports/report.json --verbose
